name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1970, Deepak Nitrite Ltd manufactures Basic Intermediates, Fine & Speciality Chemicals, Performance Products, and Phenolics

flags.text: Operating margin compressed 3.0 pts in 3 years (16% → 13%).
Sales growing faster than profit (revenue -0.4% vs PAT -13.5% 3y CAGR) — growth is getting more expensive.
Negative cumulative free cash flow over 5 years (₹-114 Cr) — growth is being funded externally.

docs.label: Nov 2026
docs.tone_why: Management highlighted record quarterly performance, robust domestic demand, strong execution, and strategic long-term capex plans.

guidance.statement: Advanced Intermediates Q3 EBIT percentage expected between Q1 and Q2, closer to Q1, with Q4 percentage better than Q3.
guidance.target: closer to Q1 % in Q3, Q4 % > Q3 %
guidance.quote: we expect Q3, in terms of EBIT percentage, somewhere between Q1 and Q2, I think closer to Q1... in Q4 EBIT percentage should be better than Q3.

guidance.statement: AI segment FY27 EBIT targeted around INR 240 crore, rising to INR 400-420 crore next year.
guidance.quote: I would expect about another INR 240 crore is what we're seeing this year. And if I was to look at next year, it would be roughly in the range of about INR 400 crore, INR 420 crore.

guidance.statement: Targeting 14% to 15% EBIT margin for Advanced Intermediates next year at steady-state asset utilization.
guidance.quote: in the next year, with all the assets that have been commissioned running at steady-state, we should be targeting something along the lines of about 14% to 15% EBIT.

guidance.statement: Cash capex expected at INR 800-900 crore in H2 FY27, INR 2,200-2,400 crore in FY28, INR 2,500 crore in FY29.
guidance.quote: around INR 800 crore to INR 900 crore further in the second half... INR 2,200 crore-INR 2,400 crore next year, INR 2,500 crore in the second year... INR 2,500 crore-INR 3,000 crore [in third year].

guidance.statement: Total 4-year capex plan expected to reach INR 11,700 crore.
guidance.quote: INR 11,700 crore.

guidance.statement: Integrated propylene to polycarbonate asset commissioning aligned with FY30 availability; PC resin plant expected earlier in FY29.
guidance.target: FY29 for resin, FY30 for integrated asset
guidance.quote: polycarbonate resin plant commissioning is actually slated earlier than that. So we continue to remain in line with our FY29 number. However, the integrated asset... is in line with the feedstock availability plan.

pushback.concern: Delay in polycarbonate commissioning timeline pushed back to FY30 from FY29.
Phenolic spreads sustainability and impact of new entrant coming into Indian market.
Whether record Phenolics margins are due to a temporary commodity super-cycle.
Caution over Chinese excess capacity pressure reported in investor presentation versus previous anti-involution narrative.

achieved.claim: Achieved record highest ever consolidated Q2 revenue of INR 3,091 crore and EBITDA of INR 643 crore.
Phenolics recorded highest ever quarterly revenue of INR 2,291 crore, up 72% YoY.
H1 FY27 EBIT of INR 933 crore in Phenolics surpassed previous highest annual EBIT of FY22.
Commissioned chlorination, photohalogenation, and specialty chemicals plant in Dahej with ~INR 300 crore capex.

docs.label: Aug 2026
docs.tone_why: Management highlighted record-high quarterly revenue/EBITDA, successful debt financial closure, and operational debottlenecking progress.

guidance.statement: Expects to spend around INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore further in FY27.
guidance.quote: Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further.

guidance.statement: Planning INR 70-odd crore further investment to debottleneck phenol assets to reach 4 lakh tonnes capacity.
guidance.quote: we are going to make, I think, about some INR 70-odd crore investment further in debottlenecking the assets to be able to touch about 4 lakh tonnes.

guidance.statement: Targeting H2 FY29 for polycarbonate commissioning, followed by BPA a couple of months later.
guidance.quote: I would anticipate that we would target H2 for our polycarbonate commissioning. And we would target BPA, which would be commissioned maybe a couple of months after that.

guidance.statement: Peak debt expected around INR 8,000 to INR 8,500 crore with debt-to-equity ratio remaining under 1.
guidance.quote: So that would be somewhere around INR 8,000 crore to INR 8,500 crore. But debt-to-equity ratio will be very, very comfortable. It will not cross even 1.

guidance.statement: Planned capex for FY27 and FY28 combined is around INR 3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: Plus further, whatever we are going to spend in 2027, 2028 will be another INR 3,000 crore. That is the plan on the capex for this year and next year.

pushback.concern: Analyst asked to quantify incremental top line and EBITDA margin contributions from upcoming commissioned products.
Analyst asked if phenolics quarterly profitability and spreads are sustainable or likely to moderate.
Analyst questioned why sustained R&D investments haven't translated into structurally higher gross margins.
Analyst asked if polycarbonate project target gross margin will reach ~60%.

achieved.claim: Delivered highest ever quarterly consolidated revenue of INR 2,592 crore, up 35% YoY.
Achieved record quarterly EBITDA of INR 554 crore, growing 159% YoY.
Phenolics business delivered highest ever quarterly performance with revenue of INR 1,775 crore.
Advanced Intermediates revenue rose 33% YoY to INR 804 crore with 89% EBIT growth.

docs.label: May 2026
docs.tone_why: Management highlighted strategic RM stockpiling, margin expansion, sequential profitability gains, and clear capex execution plans.

guidance.statement: Polycarbonate resin plant project expected to be commissioned by June 2028.
guidance.quote: we are expecting it to be commissioned by June 2028.

guidance.statement: INR 11,000 crore total project funding tied up with banks in a 60-40 debt to equity ratio.
guidance.quote: The funding is for all the projects together. We have tied up with the banks for debt. It will be in the ratio of 60-40.

guidance.statement: Agrochemical intermediates and MIBK/MIBC projects scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27.
guidance.quote: multipurpose agrochemical intermediates and MIBK, MIBC projects, which are scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27.

guidance.statement: Commercial production of fluorinated and non-fluorinated molecules anticipated on regularized basis from Q3 FY27 onwards.
guidance.quote: we anticipate commercial production on a regularized basis from Q3 onwards

guidance.statement: Expects stronger margin profile for standalone business in FY27 compared to FY26 due to new accretive products.
guidance.quote: Therefore, in FY27, we expect a stronger margin profile, even for the standalone business, compared with FY26.

guidance.statement: Expects Q1 FY27 performance to be better sequentially than Q4 FY26 on standalone and consolidated levels.
guidance.quote: I can say that our Q1 looks on track for numbers, which are better than Q4, whether it is on standalone or on a consolidated basis.

pushback.concern: Technical issues leading to suboptimal 45% utilization at the newly started nitric acid plant.
Suboptimal utilization and raw material availability constraints for Phenolics business.
Increase in receivable days and potential underutilization in Advanced Intermediates.
Discrepancy in Phenol spreads between China and India impacting local pricing.

achieved.claim: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenues stood at INR 2,127 crore with 18% EBITDA margin.
EBITDA for Q4 FY26 reached INR 383 crore, a sequential growth of 74%.
Successfully commissioned, stabilized, and ramped up nitration and hydrogenation facilities at Dahej in FY26.
Q4 FY26 PAT grew 120% quarter-on-quarter to INR 220 crore.

docs.label: Feb 2026
docs.tone_why: Management emphasizes strong integration advantages, operating leverage gains, volume growth, and expected performance recovery.

guidance.statement: Targeting MIBK/MIBC project commissioning within Q3 FY26.
guidance.quote: The MIBK/ MIBC project is progressing well and is targeted for commissioning within this quarter.

guidance.statement: Group expects a favourable performance in Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: With this positive backdrop, the Group expects a favourable performance in Q4 FY26.

guidance.statement: Photochemical, chlorination, fluorination asset utilizations to pick up in Q1 FY27; high-pressure alkylation asset ramp-up mid-2026.
guidance.quote: chlorination and fluorination, that we expect those utilizations to pick up in Q1 FY27... high- pressure alkylation asset... June and July 2026

guidance.statement: Targeting total spending of INR 100 crore in FY26 remaining, and around INR 2,500 crore in FY27.
guidance.quote: INR 2,500 crore is for FY27, not FY26. FY26 is already underway, that would involve spending of around INR 100 crore

pushback.concern: Is destocking the main reason for Advanced Intermediates margin compression or selling extra volume at lower margins?
What led to the nearly two-year delay in commercialization of the MIBK/MIBC project?

achieved.claim: Consolidated Q3 FY26 revenue grew 3% YoY to INR 1,983 crore.
Q3 FY26 EBITDA increased by 16% YoY to INR 219 crore.
Phenolics EBIT grew 20% YoY reaching INR 145 crore.
Advanced Intermediates Q3 FY26 revenue grew 18% YoY to INR 652 crore.

ar.what_they_do: Deepak Nitrite manufactures and sells chemicals, operating primarily across Advanced Intermediates and Phenolics segments, while expanding into advanced materials and speciality chemicals.

segments.name: Advanced Intermediates
segments.note: Core operations built on nitration and hydrogenation chemistries.

drivers: Expanding domestic consumption base driven by rising incomes and urbanisation.
Import substitution and value chain integration.
Realignment of global supply chains creating export opportunities.

watch.text: All related party transactions were conducted on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business.

ar.label: Annual Report 2026

verdict.tldr: Deepak Nitrite is pivoting from a low-margin commodity cycle to a massive ₹11,700 crore capex-led expansion, though negative free cash flow and rising debt warrant caution despite recent record profits.

promises.promise: Q1 FY27 performance to be better sequentially than Q4 FY26 on standalone and consolidated levels.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹2,578 Cr vs ₹2,120 Cr in Q4 FY26.
promises.why: Revenue grew 21.6% and PAT grew 56.8% sequentially.

promises.promise: Polycarbonate resin plant project expected to be commissioned by June 2028.
promises.actual: Management confirmed resin plant remains on track for FY29 in later calls.
promises.why: Timeline reiterated in Q2 FY27 call despite integrated asset delays.

promises.promise: Advanced Intermediates segment FY27 EBIT targeted around INR 240 crore.
promises.actual: Not yet fully reported for the fiscal year.
promises.why: Only H1 FY27 data is currently available.

promises.promise: Total 4-year capex plan expected to reach INR 11,700 crore.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show borrowings rose to ₹1,762 Cr to fund expansion.
promises.why: Management detailed specific annual spends through FY30.

promises.promise: Peak debt expected around INR 8,000 to INR 8,500 crore with debt-to-equity under 1.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show current debt-to-equity is 0.27.
promises.why: Current debt levels remain well below the projected peak.

promises.promise: MIBK/MIBC project targeted for commissioning within Q3 FY26.
promises.actual: Project was later scheduled for Q2 FY27 commissioning.
promises.why: Management admitted to a nearly two-year delay in commercialization.

credibility.line: Management delivers on short-term sequential growth but has a history of multi-year project delays and evasive answers on specific margin targets.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims strong execution and strategic long-term capex plans.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show negative 5-year cumulative free cash flow of ₹-114 Cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management highlights record quarterly performance and robust domestic demand.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show Q2 FY27 revenue grew 61.7% YoY.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims debt-to-equity ratio will remain very comfortable.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show borrowings increased 6.2x in three years.

bull.point: Explosive revenue growth in Phenolics segment.

bull.evidence: Q2 FY27 op profit grew 207.4% YoY.

bear.point: Growth is becoming increasingly capital intensive.

bear.evidence: Borrowings rose from ₹286 Cr to ₹1,762 Cr.
OPM fell from 16% to 13% over 3 years.

watch_next: Advanced Intermediates EBIT reaching the ₹240 Cr FY27 target.
Sustainability of Phenolics spreads against new domestic competition.
Adherence to the June 2028 Polycarbonate resin plant timeline.
